findings.claim: 20-F 列印尼 KPPU 對司機夥伴合作安排（GrabExpress、GrabFood、特殊租賃運輸）的調查，以及 P2P 利率卡特爾指控程序，仍在進行。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 8 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: In 2024 and 2025, KPPU investigated our partnership arrangements with driver-partners for (i) GrabExpress and GrabFood delivery and (ii) special rental transportation with other ride-hailing applicators. In addition, KPPU has initiated proceedings regarding a cartel allegation involving the determination of P2P interest rates by the Indonesian Fintech Peer-to-Peer Funding Association,of which our relevant subsidiary is a member. The proceedings are still ongoing.
